## Description
Brief summary of the proposed changes.

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature or test mode
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code refactoring without behavior changes
- [ ] `style`: Formatting, UI/CSS refinements
- [ ] `test`: Unit tests or testing infrastructure
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, workflow, or dependency updates

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits and is **<= 62 characters**.
- [ ] All commit messages on this branch are **<= 62 characters**.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes with 0 errors (typecheck, lint, jscpd, test, build).
- [ ] Documentation and single-sentence README constraint preserved.
